routines.title: Gentle Test Routine
routines.summary: A short mixed session: arm raises, sit-to-stand, and a quiet balance hold.

steps.title: Arm Raise
steps.instruction: Raise both arms out to shoulder height, then lower them. Repeat 5 times.

steps.title: Sit to Stand
steps.instruction: From a seated position, stand up fully, then sit back down. Repeat 5 times at your own pace.

steps.title: Balance Hold
steps.instruction: Stand with hips level and stay still for a short hold. Repeat 5 steady holds.

routines.title: Arm Mobility
routines.summary: Focus on shoulder-height arm raises only — good as a warm-up or stand-alone session.

steps.title: Arm Raise
steps.instruction: Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, hold briefly, then lower. Repeat 8 times.

routines.title: Chair Strength
routines.summary: Sit-to-stand practice from a sturdy chair. Use the armrests if you need them.

steps.title: Sit to Stand
steps.instruction: From a seated position, stand up fully, then sit back down with control. Repeat 8 times at your own pace.

routines.title: Steady Balance
routines.summary: Quiet standing holds to practice keeping your hips level and still.

steps.title: Balance Hold
steps.instruction: Stand with feet grounded and hips level. Stay still for each short hold. Repeat 6 steady holds.

routines.title: Quick Warm-Up
routines.summary: A shorter two-step session: light arm raises, then a brief balance hold.

steps.title: Arm Raise
steps.instruction: Raise both arms out to shoulder height, then lower them. Repeat 4 times.

steps.title: Balance Hold
steps.instruction: Stand quietly with hips level for a short hold. Repeat 3 steady holds.
